rationale: The agent properly verified the user using full name + zip, which matched a single account. They reviewed the user's recent orders with tablets via read-only tools, correctly identified both tablet items and their details, and asked the user to choose which to return and specify the refund destination. When the user chose the gold 128GB tablet, the agent accurately noted it was purchased with a gift card and explained refunds must go to the original method or a gift card. The agent requested explicit confirmation to proceed with a refund to the gift card, received it, and then executed the return using the correct order and item IDs. The order status updated to return requested, and the agent confirmed the action and refund destination to the user without fabricating details. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, and no writes occurred without confirmation.
